concept.prompt:
SUBJECT: single game prop concept for image-to-3D, an original cultivation artifact: a square jade seal (ấn) about 15 cm wide, pale green-white translucent-looking jade block with soft rounded corners, the top carved as a single blooming lotus in full relief with eight thick rounded petals standing on a small bronze-capped base, a thick bronze band around the lower body, the bottom face plain, a few hand-painted fine gold inlay lines along the edges (NO letters, NO carved characters), solid heavy silhouette. THREE-QUARTER VIEW from slightly above (about 25 degrees), floating upright with nothing under it, the whole object complete in frame, solid compact construction as one single mesh-friendly object, no loose small parts, no dangling thin chains.
STYLE: semi-realistic stylized 3D game asset concept for a Chinese fantasy cultivation world, cinematic painterly quality, believable materials with hand-painted detail: polished bronze, aged gold-purple lacquer, jade, weathered stone, silk cord, clear readable silhouette, large shapes first and fine detail second, color guide (use only what the subject needs): bronze (#AE8B49), dark wood (#4D3324), cinnabar red (#9D392E), ivory (#E6DDCB), dark teal (#2B5552), jade green (#7FE3D0) only as a small painted accent, stone greys (#BDB6A4, #7D786C).
RENDER: neutral flat even studio lighting, soft diffuse light from the front, no strong directional shadows, no dramatic lighting, no colored rim light, no color cast, neutral white balance, plain light grey seamless background (#D8D8D8), no floor shadow, orthographic camera, whole subject centered and fully inside the frame with generous margin on all sides.
AVOID: no text, no letters, no calligraphy, no seal script, no watermark, no logo, no signature, no glow, no bloom, no light rays, no particles, no sparks, no smoke, no fog, no mist, no snow, no magic effects, no aura, no energy, no cel shading, no toon outlines, no black contour lines, no flat cartoon colors, no anime style, no photograph, no plastic look, no baked dramatic shadows, no night scene, no purple tint on the background, no ground, no stand, no table, no background scenery, no hands, no people, no second object, no cropped parts.
